```sql
SELECT SUM(r.points) AS total_points
FROM main.results r
JOIN main.races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN main.drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.driverRef = 'button'
  AND ra.year = 2009
```
